title: A General Reinforcement Learning Algorithm that Masters Chess, Shogi, Go and Atari (Agent57)
description: First RL agent to outperform human players on ALL 57 Atari games. Adaptive meta-controller balancing exploration. Showed RL can achieve broad generalization.
authors: Badia, Piot, Kapturowski, Sprechmann, Vitvitskyi, Guo, Blundell
